name: Archer
strategyNote: Mass Skirmishers trade for free. If they're massing, add a Mangonel or dive them with Scouts/Eagles before they upgrade.
strategyNoteEs: Los guerrilleros en masa ganan el intercambio gratis. Si los acumulan, agrega un mangonel o cae con exploradores/águilas antes de que mejoren.

name: Crossbowman
strategyNote: Skirmishers + one Mangonel behind. Knights force them off gold; don't fight them with slow infantry in the open.
strategyNoteEs: Guerrilleros + un mangonel detrás. Los caballeros los sacan del oro; no pelees con infantería lenta en campo abierto.

name: Arbalester
strategyNote: Elite Skirms + Onager shots on the clump, or Hussar/Eagle dives from two sides so they can't kite one way.
strategyNoteEs: Guerrilleros de élite + tiros de onagro al montón, o cargas de húsares/águilas por dos lados para que no puedan kitear.

name: Skirmisher
strategyNote: Only hurts archers. Anything melee (Scouts, Men-at-Arms, Eagles) kills them for free — never shoot Skirms with archers.
strategyNoteEs: Solo daña arqueros. Cualquier unidad melee (exploradores, hombres de armas, águilas) los mata gratis — nunca les dispares con arqueros.

name: Elite Skirmisher
strategyNote: Melee units beat them for free. If you're an archer civ, add siege or cavalry instead of trading arrows.
strategyNoteEs: Las unidades melee les ganan gratis. Si eres civ de arqueros, agrega asedio o caballería en vez de intercambiar flechas.

name: Spearman
strategyNote: Never charge cavalry in. Shoot them with Archers/Skirms or fight with your own infantry.
strategyNoteEs: Nunca cargues caballería contra ellos. Mátalos con arqueros/guerrilleros o con tu propia infantería.

name: Pikeman
strategyNote: Bait them with cavalry, kill them with ranged units or swordsmen. Onagers erase pike masses.
strategyNoteEs: Provócalos con caballería y mátalos con unidades a distancia o espadachines. Los onagros borran masas de piqueros.

name: Halberdier
strategyNote: Pure counter unit: kite with any ranged unit. Only engage with cavalry after they're thinned out.
strategyNoteEs: Unidad counter pura: kitea con cualquier unidad a distancia. Solo entra con caballería cuando ya estén diezmados.

name: Militia
strategyNote: A couple of Men-at-Arms or archers behind walls stop a Drush. Keep villagers together and garrison if needed.
strategyNoteEs: Un par de hombres de armas o arqueros tras muros paran un drush. Junta a tus aldeanos y guarnece si hace falta.

name: Man-at-Arms
strategyNote: Archers kite them to death; towers and TC fire blunt the rush. Don't meet them with Skirmishers.
strategyNoteEs: Los arqueros los matan kiteando; torres y el fuego del TC frenan el rush. No los enfrentes con guerrilleros.

name: Long Swordsman
strategyNote: Kite with Crossbows or Cav Archers; they're slow — raid their eco elsewhere while they walk.
strategyNoteEs: Kitea con ballesteros o arqueros a caballo; son lentos — raidea su economía mientras caminan.

name: Two-Handed Swordsman
strategyNote: Hand Cannoneers or massed Arbalesters shred them; Onagers punish the clump. Avoid prolonged melee.
strategyNoteEs: Arcabuceros o arbalistas en masa los destrozan; el onagro castiga el montón. Evita el melee prolongado.

name: Champion
strategyNote: Hand Cannoneers + a meat shield, or Cav Archers kiting. Never let them reach your Skirms/siege.
strategyNoteEs: Arcabuceros + escudo de carne, o arqueros a caballo kiteando. Nunca dejes que lleguen a tus guerrilleros/asedio.

name: Scout Cavalry
strategyNote: Spears + TC fire stop the rush. Wall your resources; a few Skirms die to Scouts, so use spears.
strategyNoteEs: Lanceros + fuego del TC paran el rush. Amuralla tus recursos; los guerrilleros pierden contra exploradores, usa lanceros.

name: Light Cavalry
strategyNote: Pikemen at your eco, Camels if you have them. They hunt Monks and siege — screen yours.
strategyNoteEs: Piqueros en tu economía, camellos si los tienes. Cazan monjes y asedio — protege los tuyos.

name: Hussar
strategyNote: Halberdiers hold the line cheaply; add Camels or your own heavy cavalry to actually kill the mass.
strategyNoteEs: Los alabarderos aguantan barato; agrega camellos o tu propia caballería pesada para matar la masa.

name: Knight
strategyNote: Pikes in front, Monks or Camels behind. Wall your eco — Knights win by raiding, not by fighting Pikes.
strategyNoteEs: Piqueros al frente, monjes o camellos detrás. Amuralla tu eco — los caballeros ganan raideando, no peleando contra piqueros.

name: Cavalier
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks, or mass Camels. Keep your archers behind the spear wall at all times.
strategyNoteEs: Alabarderos + monjes, o camellos en masa. Mantén a tus arqueros detrás del muro de lanzas siempre.

name: Paladin
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks is the gold-efficient answer; Heavy Camels trade well. Never fight them in the open with archers alone.
strategyNoteEs: Alabarderos + monjes es la respuesta eficiente en oro; los camellos pesados intercambian bien. Nunca los enfrentes en campo abierto solo con arqueros.

name: Camel Rider
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry only. Beat them with Pikemen, archers or infantry — never with your Knights.
strategyNoteEs: Solo anti-caballería. Véncelos con piqueros, arqueros o infantería — nunca con tus caballeros.

name: Heavy Camel Rider
strategyNote: Keep your cavalry away; kill Camels with Halbs, archers or Champions. They melt to arrows.
strategyNoteEs: Aleja tu caballería; mata camellos con alabarderos, arqueros o campeones. Se derriten ante flechas.

name: Monk
strategyNote: Spread units, keep Light Cav/Eagles to snipe Monks, or shoot them first — every conversion is a double loss.
strategyNoteEs: Dispersa unidades, ten caballería ligera/águilas para cazar monjes, o dispárales primero — cada conversión es pérdida doble.

name: Eagle Scout
strategyNote: Early Eagle raids: a few Men-at-Arms or spears at each eco spot; wall early.
strategyNoteEs: Raids tempranos de águilas: algunos hombres de armas o lanceros en cada recurso; amuralla temprano.

name: Eagle Warrior
strategyNote: Swordsmen crush Eagles. Avoid archer-only armies — Eagles are built to eat them and your siege.
strategyNoteEs: Los espadachines trituran águilas. Evita ejércitos de solo arqueros — las águilas se los comen junto con tu asedio.

name: Elite Eagle Warrior
strategyNote: Champions/Legionaries head-on; garrison siege when the swarm dives. Don't rely on arrows alone.
strategyNoteEs: Campeones de frente; guarnece el asedio cuando entre el enjambre. No dependas solo de flechas.

name: Hand Cannoneer
strategyNote: Anti-infantry: charge with Knights/Hussars (they're inaccurate vs fast units) or outrange with Arbalest + Onager.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-infantería: carga con caballeros/húsares (fallan contra unidades rápidas) o gana alcance con arbalista + onagro.

name: Cavalry Archer
strategyNote: Skirmishers + Camels/Hussars to run them down. Fight near your base so they can't kite forever.
strategyNoteEs: Guerrilleros + camellos/húsares para alcanzarlos. Pelea cerca de tu base para que no kiteen eternamente.

name: Bombard Cannon
strategyNote: Fast cavalry snipes it in two hits. Never park siege or massed archers in its range.
strategyNoteEs: La caballería rápida lo mata en dos golpes. Nunca dejes asedio o masa de arqueros en su rango.

name: Siege Ram
strategyNote: Melee units (even villagers) chop Rams fast; Mangonels help. Arrows are useless — never defend with archers only.
strategyNoteEs: Las unidades melee (incluso aldeanos) pican arietes rápido; los mangoneles ayudan. Las flechas son inútiles — nunca defiendas solo con arqueros.

name: Onager
strategyNote: Split your army before engaging; snipe it with cavalry. One good shot erases a Skirm/archer mass.
strategyNoteEs: Divide tu ejército antes de entrar; cázalo con caballería. Un buen tiro borra una masa de guerrilleros/arqueros.

name: Heavy Scorpion
strategyNote: Same: cavalry from two sides or your own Onagers. Never walk infantry into the firing line.
strategyNoteEs: Igual: caballería por dos lados o tus propios onagros. Nunca metas infantería a la línea de tiro.

name: Imperial Skirmisher
strategyNote: Same rule as all Skirms: run them down with cavalry or infantry, never with ranged units.
strategyNoteEs: Misma regla que todo guerrillero: bárrelos con caballería o infantería, nunca con unidades a distancia.

name: Genitour
strategyNote: Mounted Skirm: only hurts archers. Melee cavalry or infantry deal with it easily.
strategyNoteEs: Guerrillero montado: solo daña arqueros. Caballería melee o infantería lo resuelven fácil.

name: Condottiero
strategyNote: Anti-gunpowder: if you're going Hand Cannoneers, switch — archers and cavalry handle them.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-pólvora: si ibas por arcabuceros, cambia — arqueros y caballería lo manejan.

name: Missionary
strategyNote: Mobile Monk: same answer — Light Cavalry snipes; don't clump expensive units near it.
strategyNoteEs: Monje móvil: misma respuesta — la caballería ligera lo caza; no amontones unidades caras cerca.

name: Flemish Militia
strategyNote: One-time eco army: whittle it with archers/HC and raid — they can't remake villagers.
strategyNoteEs: Ejército-economía de un solo uso: desgástalo con arqueros/arcabuceros y raidea — no pueden rehacer aldeanos.

name: Houfnice
strategyNote: Upgraded Bombard: snipe it with fast cavalry raids before the push arrives.
strategyNoteEs: Bombardeo mejorado: cázalo con raids de caballería rápida antes de que llegue el push.

name: Imperial Camel Rider
strategyNote: Ultimate anti-cavalry: switch off Knights entirely — go archers + Halbs or infantry.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-caballería definitivo: abandona los caballeros — ve por arqueros + alabarderos o infantería.

name: Chu Ko Nu
strategyNote: Melts infantry up close: Onagers + Skirms from range, or cavalry dive with armor upgrades.
strategyNoteEs: Derrite infantería de cerca: onagros + guerrilleros desde lejos, o carga de caballería con mejoras de armadura.

name: Leitis
strategyNote: Ignores armor in melee — your Paladins/Teutonic Knights lose value. Halbs, Monks and ranged mass instead.
strategyNoteEs: Ignora la armadura en melee — tus paladines/caballeros teutónicos pierden valor. Alabarderos, monjes y masa a distancia.

name: Longbowman
strategyNote: Outranges everything on foot: close the distance with Knights/Sicilian-style cavalry or Onagers; Skirms need siege support.
strategyNoteEs: Supera el alcance de todo lo terrestre: cierra distancia con caballeros u onagros sobre su masa; los guerrilleros necesitan asedio.

name: Throwing Axeman
strategyNote: Ranged infantry: cavalry closes the gap fast; archers outrange them.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería a distancia: la caballería cierra rápido; los arqueros lo superan en alcance.

name: Huskarl
strategyNote: Anti-archer: stop shooting it. Champions, Jaguars, Cataphracts or cavalry in melee.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-arqueros: deja de dispararle. Campeones, jaguares, catafractas o caballería en melee.

name: War Elephant
strategyNote: Extremely slow: mass Halbs + Monks converts or kills the investment. Raid their eco — they can't defend it.
strategyNoteEs: Lentísimo: masa de alabarderos + monjes convierte o mata la inversión. Raidea su eco — no puede defenderla.

name: Jaguar Warrior
strategyNote: Anti-infantry: never send Champions/Eagles in. Archers and cavalry beat them cleanly.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-infantería: nunca mandes campeones/águilas. Arqueros y caballería les ganan limpio.

name: Cataphract
strategyNote: Anti-infantry cavalry: Pikes are NOT the answer. Mass Camels, Monks, or ranged units + siege.
strategyNoteEs: Caballería anti-infantería: los piqueros NO son la respuesta. Camellos en masa, monjes o unidades a distancia + asedio.

name: Samurai
strategyNote: Anti-unique: keep your unique unit home; fight with generic Knights/archers instead.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-únicas: guarda tu unidad única; pelea con caballeros/arqueros genéricos.

name: Mangudai
strategyNote: Kill them before mass: Camels + Hussars chasing, Elite Skirms holding. A slow deathball loses the map.
strategyNoteEs: Mátalos antes de la masa crítica: camellos + húsares persiguiendo, guerrilleros de élite aguantando. Un ejército lento pierde el mapa.

name: Conquistador
strategyNote: Mounted gunpowder: Skirms do poorly — use Camels/Knights to close, Onagers on the clump.
strategyNoteEs: Pólvora montada: los guerrilleros rinden poco — usa camellos/caballeros para cerrar, onagros al montón.

name: Plumed Archer
strategyNote: Fast archer: Elite Skirms still counter; add Hussars to chase. Don't chase with Champions.
strategyNoteEs: Arquero rápido: los guerrilleros de élite siguen siendo counter; agrega húsares para perseguir. No persigas con campeones.

name: Tarkan
strategyNote: Building raider. Castle drops and walls suffer — keep Halbs/Camels near your base and repair.
strategyNoteEs: Raider de edificios. Castillos y muros sufren — ten alabarderos/camellos cerca de tu base y repara.

name: Berserk
strategyNote: Self-healing infantry: burst them down with Hand Cannoneers/Jaguars; don't trade slowly.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería que se cura: reviéntalos rápido con arcabuceros/jaguares; no intercambies lento.

name: Janissary
strategyNote: Outranges Skirms: dive with cavalry in two prongs, or trade with massed Arbalesters + siege.
strategyNoteEs: Supera el alcance de los guerrilleros: entra con caballería por dos flancos, o intercambia con arbalistas en masa + asedio.

name: Kamayuk
strategyNote: Extra range beats cavalry hard — fight them with Arbalesters/Hand Cannoneers, not with Knights.
strategyNoteEs: Su alcance extra vence a la caballería — pelea con arbalistas/arcabuceros, no con caballeros.

name: Slinger
strategyNote: Anti-infantry ranged: cavalry or Eagles dive them; never walk swordsmen in.
strategyNoteEs: Anti-infantería a distancia: caballería o águilas los cazan; nunca camines espadachines hacia ellos.

name: Ballista Elephant
strategyNote: Cuts through lines: Halberdiers + Monks (it's still an elephant); avoid tight formations.
strategyNoteEs: Corta líneas enteras: alabarderos + monjes (sigue siendo elefante); evita formaciones cerradas.

name: Shotel Warrior
strategyNote: Fast shock infantry: TC fire + archers behind walls; they die fast to everything if you don't get surprised.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería de choque rápida: fuego del TC + arqueros tras muros; mueren rápido ante todo si no te sorprenden.

name: Mameluke
strategyNote: Ranged camel: archers + Halbs (they still counter cavalry). Onager shots hurt the expensive mass badly.
strategyNoteEs: Camello a distancia: arqueros + alabarderos (sigue siendo anti-caballería). Los tiros de onagro duelen mucho a esa masa cara.

name: Gbeto
strategyNote: Ranged infantry, fragile: cavalry dives kill them; don't trade with slow melee.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería a distancia, frágil: las cargas de caballería la matan; no intercambies con melee lento.

name: Teutonic Knight
strategyNote: Melee death, but crawls: kite forever with any ranged unit; never ever melee it.
strategyNoteEs: Muerte en melee, pero lentísimo: kitea por siempre con cualquier unidad a distancia; jamás lo enfrentes en melee.

name: War Wagon
strategyNote: Tanky CA: mass Halbs + Onagers, or Camels diving. Small archer numbers bounce off it.
strategyNoteEs: Arquero a caballo tanque: masa de alabarderos + onagros, o camellos cargando. Pocos arqueros rebotan contra él.

name: Genoese Crossbowman
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry archer: stop making Knights; Skirms + Onagers or infantry win.
strategyNoteEs: Arquero anti-caballería: deja de hacer caballeros; guerrilleros + onagros o infantería ganan.

name: Magyar Huszar
strategyNote: Treat as Hussar: Halbs + Camels. Don't waste gold units chasing a trash raid unit.
strategyNoteEs: Trátalo como húsar: alabarderos + camellos. No gastes unidades de oro persiguiendo una unidad de raideo barata.

name: Boyar
strategyNote: Melee armor tank: arrows do little. Halberdiers and Monks, or mass Camels — don't melee with Knights.
strategyNoteEs: Tanque de armadura melee: las flechas hacen poco. Alabarderos y monjes, o camellos en masa — no hagas melee con caballeros.

name: Woad Raider
strategyNote: Fastest infantry — it catches your archers: screen with cavalry or meet it with your own swordsmen.
strategyNoteEs: La infantería más rápida — alcanza a tus arqueros: pantalla de caballería o recíbelo con tus espadachines.

name: Arambai
strategyNote: Deadly but inaccurate: spread out, rush them with Hussars/Eagles — never clump Skirms.
strategyNoteEs: Letal pero impreciso: dispérsate, cárgalos con húsares/águilas — nunca amontones guerrilleros.

name: Organ Gun
strategyNote: Shreds clumped infantry: send cavalry from the flanks; Bombard Cannons outrange it.
strategyNoteEs: Tritura infantería amontonada: manda caballería por los flancos; el cañón de bombardeo lo supera en alcance.

name: Rattan Archer
strategyNote: Ignores Skirmishers (high pierce armor): use Onagers, cavalry or infantry instead.
strategyNoteEs: Ignora a los guerrilleros (alta armadura perforante): usa onagros, caballería o infantería.

name: Camel Archer
strategyNote: Counters other CA; against you: Skirms + Camels, and close the distance with buildings/walls.
strategyNoteEs: Countera otros arqueros a caballo; contra ti: guerrilleros + camellos, y cierra distancia con edificios/muros.

name: Obuch
strategyNote: Strips armor: keep expensive melee units away; shoot it down with archers/HC.
strategyNoteEs: Desarma la armadura: aleja tus unidades melee caras; derríbalo con arqueros/arcabuceros.

name: Hussite Wagon
strategyNote: Mobile wall: get behind it with cavalry or Rams; melee it down — arrows are wasted.
strategyNoteEs: Muro móvil: rodéalo con caballería o arietes; derríbalo en melee — las flechas se desperdician.

name: Coustillier
strategyNote: Charge attack hits once, then it's a weak Knight. Absorb the charge with Halbs/tanky units, then swarm.
strategyNoteEs: Su carga golpea una vez y luego es un caballero débil. Absorbe la carga con alabarderos/unidades tanque y abruma.

name: Serjeant
strategyNote: Tanky but slow: kite with archers; ignore the Donjons and raid elsewhere.
strategyNoteEs: Tanque pero lento: kitea con arqueros; ignora los donjones y raidea en otro lado.

name: Konnik
strategyNote: Kills twice (dismounts to infantry). Halbs + archers clean both forms; Onagers hit the dismounted clump.
strategyNoteEs: Mata dos veces (desmonta a infantería). Alabarderos + arqueros limpian ambas formas; onagro al montón desmontado.

name: Ratha
strategyNote: Switches melee/ranged: Camels + Elite Skirms cover both modes; Onager the mass.
strategyNoteEs: Cambia entre melee y distancia: camellos + guerrilleros de élite cubren ambos modos; onagro a la masa.

name: Kipchak
strategyNote: Cheap CA spam: Elite Skirms trade great; Hussars force them off. Don't chase with slow units.
strategyNoteEs: Spam barato de arqueros a caballo: los guerrilleros de élite intercambian genial; los húsares los expulsan. No persigas con unidades lentas.

name: Urumi Swordsman
strategyNote: Splash melee: never clump infantry into it; Hand Cannoneers and Cav Archers kite it.
strategyNoteEs: Melee con daño en área: nunca amontones infantería; arcabuceros y arqueros a caballo lo kitean.

name: Monaspa
strategyNote: Stronger in groups — never fight the ball head-on with cavalry. Halbs + Onagers break the mass.
strategyNoteEs: Más fuerte en grupo — nunca pelees la bola de frente con caballería. Alabarderos + onagros rompen la masa.

name: Chakram Thrower
strategyNote: Ranged splash vs infantry: spread out, dive with cavalry, or outrange with Arbalests.
strategyNoteEs: Área a distancia vs infantería: dispérsate, carga con caballería o gana alcance con arbalistas.

name: Ghulam
strategyNote: Pierces through lines: don't stack archers in files; use cavalry or your own infantry mass.
strategyNoteEs: Atraviesa líneas: no formes arqueros en fila; usa caballería o tu propia masa de infantería.

name: Karambit Warrior
strategyNote: Half-pop swarm: Onagers, Hand Cannoneers and Champions clear crowds; don't fight it with single-target gold units.
strategyNoteEs: Enjambre a medio pop: onagros, arcabuceros y campeones limpian multitudes; no pelees con unidades de oro de un solo objetivo.

name: Centurion
strategyNote: Buffs nearby militia — kill the Centurions first with Camels/Halbs, then the infantry folds to archers.
strategyNoteEs: Potencia a la milicia cercana — mata primero a los centuriones con camellos/alabarderos y la infantería cae ante arqueros.

name: Shrivamsha Rider
strategyNote: Dodges arrows — don't shoot it. Halberdiers, Camels and melee engagements shut it down.
strategyNoteEs: Esquiva flechas — no le dispares. Alabarderos, camellos y combates melee lo apagan.

name: Keshik
strategyNote: Generates gold in melee — refuse melee fights. Kite with archers, hold with Halbs.
strategyNoteEs: Genera oro en melee — niégale el melee. Kitea con arqueros, aguanta con alabarderos.

name: Flaming Camel
strategyNote: Suicide anti-cavalry bomb: spread your Knights/Elephants, or screen with one line of cheap Hussars.
strategyNoteEs: Bomba suicida anti-caballería: dispersa tus caballeros/elefantes o pon una línea de húsares baratos de pantalla.

name: Composite Bowman
strategyNote: Armor-ignoring arrows: Skirms lose value — dive with cavalry or Onager the mass.
strategyNoteEs: Flechas que ignoran armadura: los guerrilleros pierden valor — carga con caballería u onagro a la masa.

name: Savar
strategyNote: A better Paladin: same answer, more of it — Halbs + Monks + Camels, and snipe their eco.
strategyNoteEs: Un paladín mejorado: misma respuesta, en más cantidad — alabarderos + monjes + camellos, y golpea su economía.

name: Iron Pagoda
strategyNote: Very tanky cavalry: mass Halberdiers + Monks; avoid slow melee trades.
strategyNoteEs: Caballería muy tanque: masa de alabarderos + monjes; evita intercambios melee lentos.

name: White Feather Guard
strategyNote: Shu infantry: standard anti-infantry play — Hand Cannoneers, archers, Cav Archers kiting.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería Shu: juego anti-infantería estándar — arcabuceros, arqueros, arqueros a caballo kiteando.

name: Liao Dao
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry infantry: don't feed Knights; use archers + siege.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería anti-caballería: no le des caballeros; usa arqueros + asedio.

name: Tiger Cavalry
strategyNote: Anti-archer cavalry: keep a Halb/Camel screen in front of your ranged mass.
strategyNoteEs: Caballería anti-arqueros: mantén una pantalla de alabarderos/camellos frente a tu masa a distancia.

name: Xianbei Raider
strategyNote: Fast raider CA: wall + Skirms at home, Camels to chase. Don't defend with slow infantry.
strategyNoteEs: Raider rápido: muros + guerrilleros en casa, camellos para perseguir. No defiendas con infantería lenta.

name: Cao Cao
strategyNote: Hero unit leading Wei cavalry: focus-fire with massed Halbs/Camels; don't chase him with archers.
strategyNoteEs: Héroe que lidera la caballería Wei: enfócalo con masa de alabarderos/camellos; no lo persigas con arqueros.

name: Fire Archer
strategyNote: Burns buildings from range: cavalry dives and Skirm mass; repair with villagers.
strategyNoteEs: Quema edificios a distancia: cargas de caballería y masa de guerrilleros; repara con aldeanos.

name: Jian Swordsman
strategyNote: Dueling infantry: kite with ranged units; Onager the mass.
strategyNoteEs: Infantería de duelo: kitea con unidades a distancia; onagro a la masa.

name: Sun Jian
strategyNote: Hero unit: treat like a heavy Knight — spear wall + Monks, and punish the army behind him.
strategyNoteEs: Héroe: trátalo como caballero pesado — muro de lanzas + monjes, y castiga al ejército detrás de él.

name: Scorpion
strategyNote: Flank with cavalry — scorpions can't turn fights. Onagers delete scorpion lines instantly.
strategyNoteEs: Flanquea con caballería — los escorpiones no giran la pelea. Los onagros borran líneas de escorpiones al instante.

name: Mangonel
strategyNote: Never clump ranged units. Dive it with Knights/Eagles; it's helpless in melee.
strategyNoteEs: Nunca amontones unidades a distancia. Cárgalo con caballeros/águilas; es indefenso en melee.

name: Trebuchet
strategyNote: Send fast cavalry the moment it unpacks; screen with your army. Your own Trebs/Bombards answer from range.
strategyNoteEs: Manda caballería rápida apenas se despliegue; protege con tu ejército. Tus trebuchets/bombardas responden a distancia.

name: Camel Scout
strategyNote: Feudal camel that beats Scouts. Spearmen + TC fire handle it; don't fight it with your Scouts.
strategyNoteEs: Camello feudal que vence exploradores. Lanceros + fuego del TC lo manejan; no lo pelees con tus exploradores.

name: Battle Elephant
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks is the answer. Flaming Camels/Camels help. Never trade gold units head-on.
strategyNoteEs: Alabarderos + monjes es la respuesta. Camellos en llamas/camellos ayudan. Nunca intercambies unidades de oro de frente.
